title.zh-CN: 睡眠障碍与注意力下降 · 31岁女性
title.en: Sleep disturbance and difficulty concentrating · 31-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 31岁女性，睡眠变差、注意力难以集中，此后数月内出现言语错乱和肢体不自主活动。依据一篇已发表病例的历史记录分阶段回看，缺失的资料保持未知。
summary.en: A 31-year-old woman with poor sleep and difficulty concentrating develops muddled speech and involuntary limb movements over the following months. A staged review of the historical record of a published case; missing data stay unknown.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从首诊到死亡重建这例快速进展疾病的时间线（以首诊为第0天的相对时间），并指出作者所述病程时长与文中日期的矛盾。
learningOutcomes.en: Reconstruct the timeline of this rapidly progressive illness from the first visit to death (relative to the first visit as day 0) and identify the conflict between the duration the authors state and the dates in the text.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用2018年中国专家共识（及2022年修订）把记录资料分级为可能、很可能或确诊的FFI，并说出缺失的证据：自主神经表现、PSG、PET/SPECT和具体PRNP变异（D178N-129M）。
learningOutcomes.en: Grade the recorded evidence as possible, probable or definite FFI with the 2018 Chinese consensus (and its 2022 revision), naming the missing evidence: autonomic features, PSG, PET/SPECT and the specific PRNP variant (D178N-129M).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释为什么MRI、脑电图和脑脊液常规正常不能排除遗传性朊蛋白病，并在基因检测的同时安排可治疗类似疾病的检查（血清和脑脊液自身免疫性脑炎抗体、副肿瘤筛查）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why a normal MRI, EEG and routine CSF do not exclude genetic prion disease, and arrange tests for the treatable mimics (serum and CSF autoimmune-encephalitis antibodies, a paraneoplastic screen) alongside genetic testing.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按WHO 2000 TSE感染控制指南为有创操作、脑脊液和组织标本及器械落实防护，并说明为什么不需要隔离患者。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply the WHO 2000 TSE infection-control precautions to invasive procedures, CSF and tissue specimens and instruments, and explain why the patient needs no isolation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 规划遗传咨询（母系亲属、自愿的预测性检测、不推断母亲的基因状况），并在吞咽和意识恶化之前开始舒缓照护和预立医疗照护计划。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan genetic counselling (maternal-line relatives, voluntary predictive testing, no assumptions about her mother's status) and start palliative care and advance care planning before swallowing and consciousness fail.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。年龄、性别、症状、检查结果和结局按原文；姓名为化名，医院、日历日期和送检地点已去除，时间以首诊为第0天的相对时间表示。对话、问题、决策、处置选项和评分为教学设计；感染控制、遗传咨询和舒缓照护是按现行指南加入的教学内容，原报告未记录。原文的两处疑点保留并标注：病程时长（作者称约9个月，与文中日期不一致）和含义不明的“感能力差”。未记录的数据保持未知。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case. Age, sex, symptoms, results and outcome follow the source; names are pseudonyms, and the hospital, calendar dates and the testing laboratory's location are removed — times are relative to the first visit as day 0. Dialogue, questions, decisions, management options and scoring are teaching design; infection control, genetic counselling and palliative care are added from current guidance and are not recorded in the report. Two oddities of the source are kept and labelled: the duration (the authors' “about nine months” conflicts with the dates in the text) and the unclear phrase “感能力差”. Unrecorded data stay unknown.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 睡眠障碍，注意力难以集中

triageNote.zh-CN: 31岁女性，门诊首诊：近来睡不好、注意力难以集中，白天犯困。病史待询问。
triageNote.en: 31-year-old woman, first outpatient visit: sleeping badly and struggling to concentrate, sleepy in the daytime. History still to be taken.

personality.zh-CN: 31岁，礼貌而有些紧张，容易担心；记得自己哪段时间睡不好，说不清医学上的细节。病情进展后反应变慢、容易走神。
personality.en: A polite, rather tense 31-year-old who worries easily; she remembers when her sleep went wrong but not the medical details. As the illness progresses she becomes slower and easily loses her thread.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子短，偶尔停顿、想不起词；不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences, sometimes pausing for a word; no medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生您好……我最近一直睡不好，注意力也集中不了。
openingLine.en: Hello, doctor… I just haven't been sleeping properly lately, and I can't concentrate.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个我的病例里没有记录，我说不上来。
fallbackUnknown.en: That isn't recorded in my case notes, so I can't really say.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 只讲当前阶段已经揭示的病史，用自己的话说，不增减数字、时间或药名；不解释检查结果，不谈诊断。首诊时你自己回答；入院以后你说话容易颠三倒四、想不起事，近来的变化让陪同的家属补充。
actingNotes.en: Say only the history revealed in the current phase, in your own words, without adding or changing numbers, times or drug names; do not interpret results or discuss diagnoses. At the first visit you answer for yourself; from the admission onwards you lose your thread and forget things, so let your family member fill in the recent changes.

text.en: Lumbar puncture during the admission: CSF reported as showing no abnormality. The source lists no cell count, protein or glucose values and reports no 14-3-3 protein, RT-QuIC or autoimmune-encephalitis antibodies.

text.en: Ultrasound: liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen and both kidneys unremarkable. X-ray: lungs, heart and diaphragm normal. ECG: normal.

name.zh-CN: PRNP基因检测（外送）
name.en: PRNP gene test (send-out)

date.zh-CN: 首诊后约5个月专科门诊当天抽血，其后回报
date.en: Blood taken at the specialist clinic about 5 months after the first visit; reported later

text.zh-CN: PRNP（+）。报告原文仅此一项结论性写法：没有写明具体变异（例如D178N）、129位密码子基因型、杂合状态或致病性分级。作者据此诊断家族性致死性失眠症（FFI）。
text.en: PRNP (+). That single conclusion is all the report gives: no named variant (such as D178N), codon-129 genotype, zygosity or pathogenicity class. On this basis the authors diagnosed fatal familial insomnia (FFI).

note.zh-CN: 原文：“基因报告提示：PRNP (+)，从而确诊FFI”；样本送外院实验室检测。
note.en: Source wording: the genetic report showed “PRNP (+)”, “confirming FFI”; the sample went to an external laboratory.

source.zh-CN: 原文·专科门诊与基因报告
source.en: Source: specialist clinic and genetic report

name.zh-CN: 调阅后续病程与结局记录
name.en: Review the record of the later course and outcome

date.en: About 6–10 months after the first visit

text.zh-CN: 首诊后约6个月：出现气粗、肢体僵直、昏迷、呼之不应，紧急入院，经支持治疗好转出院（原文未写明具体措施）。首诊后约7–8个月：因“发热、咳痰3天，气促3小时”入院，考虑肺炎；住院期间睡眠仍差，神志清醒，吞咽功能下降、进食差，需要留置胃管。首诊后约9–10个月：因低血糖经急诊入院，意识差，进食差，营养状态差，入院第8天因呼吸衰竭死亡。原文未报告尸检、具体PRNP变异或亲属检测。
text.en: About 6 months after the first visit: laboured breathing, limb rigidity, coma and unresponsiveness led to an emergency admission; she improved with supportive treatment and went home (the measures are not described). About 7–8 months: admitted with 3 days of fever and sputum and 3 hours of breathlessness, thought to be pneumonia; during that stay she still slept badly, was alert, had worsening swallowing and poor intake, and needed a nasogastric tube. About 9–10 months: admitted through the emergency department with hypoglycaemia, poorly conscious, eating little and poorly nourished; she died of respiratory failure on day 8 of that admission. No autopsy, specific PRNP variant or testing of relatives is reported.

note.zh-CN: 病程时长前后不一致（原文保留）：讨论部分称“从发病到死亡，历时大概九个月”；按文中日期，首诊至死亡约9–10个月（首诊只记到月份），而入院主诉“紧张、多虑半年”提示症状起于首诊前约2个月，起病至死亡约12个月。原文未解释。
note.en: The duration is inconsistent in the source (kept as printed): the discussion says “about nine months from onset to death”; by the dates in the text the first visit to death is about 9–10 months (the first visit is dated only to the month), while the admission complaint of “six months of tension and overthinking” puts onset about 2 months before the first visit — about 12 months from onset to death. The source does not explain this.

source.zh-CN: 原文·病例资料（后续入院与结局）及讨论
source.en: Source: case history (later admissions and outcome) and discussion

message.zh-CN: 提示：基因检测前应向患者和家属说明检测目的、结果对亲属的意义，并取得知情同意（最好先经遗传咨询）。
message.en: Note: before genetic testing, explain to her and her family what the test is for and what the result means for relatives, and obtain consent (ideally after genetic counselling).

name.zh-CN: 转介临床遗传咨询（患者及家属）
name.en: Refer to clinical genetics for counselling (patient and family)

dose.zh-CN: 说明常染色体显性遗传及每个子女50%的遗传风险；讨论检测的目的、局限和对亲属的意义；高风险成年亲属是否做预测性检测，在遗传咨询后自愿决定（包括有权选择不知道）。
dose.en: Explain autosomal dominant inheritance and the 50% risk to each child; discuss what testing can and cannot tell, and what it means for relatives; at-risk adult relatives decide about predictive testing voluntarily after counselling (including the right not to know).

response.zh-CN: 遗传咨询门诊已预约。遗传咨询师会先和患者、家属谈基因结果的含义，并索取写明具体变异的完整报告，再讨论哪些成年亲属可能需要咨询。原报告未记录这一步。
response.en: A clinical genetics appointment is booked. The counsellor will first go through what the result means with her and her family, ask for the full report naming the variant, and then discuss which adult relatives may want counselling. The report does not record this step.

name.zh-CN: 舒缓（姑息）医疗会诊与预立医疗照护计划
name.en: Palliative care referral and advance care planning

dose.zh-CN: 趁她还能表达意愿，和她及家属讨论照护目标：营养与喂养方式（如是否放胃管）、出现肺炎或呼吸衰竭时是否抢救、在哪里照护；同时处理睡眠差、焦虑和不自主运动等症状。
dose.en: While she can still say what she wants, discuss goals of care with her and her family: nutrition and feeding (for example whether to have a feeding tube), whether to attempt resuscitation if pneumonia or respiratory failure comes, and where she would be cared for; and treat symptoms such as poor sleep, anxiety and involuntary movements.

response.zh-CN: 已请舒缓医疗团队会诊，第一次照护目标谈话已约好，患者和家属都会参加。原报告未记录舒缓医疗或预立医疗照护计划，这是按现行照护原则加入的一步。
response.en: The palliative care team is asked to see her and a first goals-of-care conversation is booked with her and her family. The report does not record palliative care or advance care planning; this step is added from current practice.

name.zh-CN: 按朊蛋白病（TSE）感染控制要求处理
name.en: Apply prion-disease (TSE) infection-control precautions

dose.zh-CN: 通知感染控制科；日常护理按标准预防，无需隔离；脑脊液和组织标本标注“疑似朊蛋白病”并告知检验科；有创操作尽量使用一次性器械，接触高感染性组织（脑、脊髓、眼）的器械按TSE专门程序灭活或销毁——常规消毒灭菌不能可靠灭活朊蛋白。
dose.en: Inform infection control; standard precautions for routine care, no isolation; label CSF and tissue specimens “suspected prion disease” and tell the laboratory; single-use instruments for invasive procedures where possible, and instruments that touch high-infectivity tissue (brain, spinal cord, eye) decontaminated by TSE-specific methods or destroyed — routine disinfection and sterilisation do not reliably inactivate prions.

response.zh-CN: 感染控制科已知悉。护士在标本申请单上标注“疑似朊蛋白病”，并向病区说明：日常护理照常、不需要隔离。原报告没有提到任何感染控制措施。
response.en: Infection control is informed. The nurse marks the specimen forms “suspected prion disease” and tells the ward that routine care carries on as usual, with no isolation. The report mentions no infection-control measures.

name.zh-CN: 单间隔离（空气和接触传播隔离）
name.en: Single-room isolation (airborne and contact precautions)

dose.zh-CN: 安排单间，所有人进入时戴N95口罩、穿隔离衣。
dose.en: A single room; everyone entering wears an N95 respirator and a gown.

response.zh-CN: 护士长提出疑问：朊蛋白病不会经空气、飞沫或日常接触传播，WHO 2000 TSE感染控制指南指出这类患者无需隔离，也不应因此被拒绝任何检查或治疗。隔离只会增加她和家属的负担，真正的风险在有创操作的器械和标本。
response.en: The ward sister queries it: prion disease does not spread by air, droplets or everyday contact, and the WHO 2000 TSE infection-control guidelines say such patients need no isolation and must not be denied any test or treatment because of it. Isolation only burdens her and her family; the real risks are instruments and specimens from invasive procedures.

name.zh-CN: 加大阿普唑仑剂量或加用其他安眠药
name.en: Increase the alprazolam or add another sleeping tablet

dose.zh-CN: 按医嘱加用或加量镇静催眠药（具体药名和剂量由医生确定）。
dose.en: Start or increase a sedative hypnotic as prescribed (drug and dose decided by the doctor).

response.zh-CN: 护士提醒：她此前已自行服用阿普唑仑，睡眠并没有改善；原报告也没有记录任何药物让她睡得更好。加量镇静催眠药不会改变病程，还可能加重意识混乱、增加跌倒风险，吞咽差或合并肺部感染时还会抑制呼吸——用之前要权衡，并说清楚目的。
response.en: The nurse points out that she has already taken alprazolam on her own without better sleep, and the report records no drug that helped her sleep. More sedative hypnotics will not change the course; they can worsen confusion and falls and, with poor swallowing or a chest infection, depress breathing — weigh it and be clear about the aim before giving it.

name.zh-CN: 停用口服避孕药（认为是病因）
name.en: Stop the contraceptive pill (as the presumed cause)

dose.zh-CN: 停用口服避孕药，月经不调另行处理。
dose.en: Stop the oral contraceptive; manage the irregular periods separately.

response.zh-CN: 可以与妇科一起重新考虑避孕和月经不调的处理，但这不会改变她的病程：原报告只记录了服药后出现睡眠变差的先后顺序，先后不等于因果。
response.en: Contraception and the irregular periods can be reconsidered with gynaecology, but this will not change her course: the report records only that the poor sleep followed the pill — sequence is not causation.

name.zh-CN: 床旁吞咽筛查并请营养科评估
name.en: Bedside swallow screen and dietitian review

dose.zh-CN: 护士床旁吞咽筛查；营养科评估进食量和营养状态。
dose.en: A nurse-led bedside swallow screen; the dietitian assesses intake and nutritional state.

response.zh-CN: 护士完成床旁吞咽筛查并请营养科会诊。原报告只在首诊后约7–8个月的肺炎住院时记录了吞咽功能下降和进食差。
response.en: The nurse completes a bedside swallow screen and asks the dietitian to review her. The report records worsening swallowing and poor intake only from the pneumonia admission about 7–8 months after the first visit.

name.zh-CN: 留置鼻胃管行肠内营养
name.en: Nasogastric tube for enteral feeding

dose.zh-CN: 吞咽评估提示经口进食不安全时，经鼻胃管给予肠内营养；先与患者和家属按照护目标讨论。
dose.en: When the swallow assessment shows oral intake is unsafe, feed through a nasogastric tube — after discussing it with her and her family in line with the goals of care.

harm.zh-CN: 此时没有吞咽困难或进食不足的记录，鼻胃管没有指征：原报告到首诊后约7–8个月的肺炎住院时才记录吞咽功能下降。
harm.en: Nothing at this point records difficulty swallowing or poor intake, so a nasogastric tube is not indicated: the report records worsening swallowing only at the pneumonia admission about 7–8 months after the first visit.

response.zh-CN: 已留置鼻胃管。原报告记录：首诊后约7–8个月因肺炎住院时吞咽功能下降、进食差，留置了胃管；约2个月后她又因低血糖、营养状态差入院。是否管饲应当是依照照护目标、与她和家属共同做出的决定，而不是吞咽变差后的自动步骤。
response.en: A nasogastric tube is placed. The report records that at the pneumonia admission about 7–8 months after the first visit her swallowing and intake had worsened and a feeding tube was placed; about 2 months later she was admitted again with hypoglycaemia and poor nutrition. Whether to tube-feed should be a decision made with her and her family against the goals of care, not an automatic step once swallowing fails.

title.en: First visit: understand the sleep problem

hint.zh-CN: 问清睡不好的具体表现、从什么时候开始、和用药的先后关系，以及胃口和体重；再问她自己吃过什么药。
hint.en: Pin down what the poor sleep is like, when it began and how it relates to any medicines, plus her appetite and weight; then ask what she has taken herself.

guidance.zh-CN: 和患者交谈：睡眠的具体情况、起病时间、体重和用药。
guidance.en: Talk to the patient: what her sleep is like, when it started, her weight and her medicines.

hint.zh-CN: 切换到入院阶段。问陪同的家属，这一两个月她说话、动作、记性和情绪有什么变化；再查记忆、计算力、肌张力和震颤。
hint.en: Switch to the admission phase. Ask her family member how her speech, movements, memory and mood have changed over the past month or two; then test memory, calculation, tone and tremor.

guidance.zh-CN: 在病房问家属近来的变化，并为患者做认知和运动检查。
guidance.en: On the ward, ask her family member about the recent changes and examine her cognition and movements.

title.zh-CN: 调阅入院检查并规划下一步
title.en: Review the admission reports and plan the next steps

hint.zh-CN: 到病历终端逐份看MRI和MRV、脑电图、脑脊液报告：正常结果能排除什么、不能排除什么？还缺哪些证据、哪些可治疗的病因还没查？
hint.en: At a records terminal, read the MRI and MRV, EEG and CSF reports one by one: what can a normal result rule out, and what can it not? What evidence is missing, and which treatable causes are still unchecked?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅入院时的检查报告，再到会诊板回答下一步检查的问题。
guidance.en: Read the admission reports at a records terminal, then answer the work-up question on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 专科门诊：家族史、基因检测与诊断分级
title.en: Specialist clinic: family history, genetic test and grading

hint.zh-CN: 家里有没有人得过类似、病程很快的病？基因报告具体写了什么、没写什么？再对照共识的核心特征和提示性特征逐项核对。
hint.en: Has anyone in the family had a similar, fast-moving illness? What exactly does the genetic report say — and leave out? Then check the consensus core and suggestive features one by one.

guidance.zh-CN: 在专科门诊追问家族史、送检并查看基因结果，再到会诊板为诊断分级。
guidance.en: At the specialist clinic, take the family history, send and read the genetic test, then grade the diagnosis on the case board.

title.en: Safety, the family and the care plan

hint.zh-CN: 她做过腰椎穿刺——标本和器械要怎么处理？需要隔离吗？家属问会不会遗传，你怎么谈、转给谁？趁她还能表达意愿，照护目标谈了吗？
hint.en: She has had a lumbar puncture — how should specimens and instruments be handled? Does she need isolation? When the family asks whether it is inherited, how do you talk about it and who do you refer to? While she can still say what she wants, have goals of care been discussed?

guidance.zh-CN: 落实感染控制、遗传咨询和舒缓照护，并在会诊板回答安全和家属沟通的问题。
guidance.en: Put infection control, genetic counselling and palliative care in place, and answer the safety and family questions on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 进入病程阶段，在病历终端核对后来的几次入院和结局；对比作者所说的病程时长和文中的时间线。
hint.en: In the course phase, check the later admissions and the outcome at a records terminal, and compare the duration the authors give with the timeline in the text.

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅后续病程与结局记录。
guidance.en: Read the record of the later course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 入院时颅脑MRI和MRV、脑电图（只有θ活动增多的轻度异常）和脑脊液常规都没有明确异常。下一步哪些措施是必要的？（多选）
prompt.en: On admission the brain MRI and MRV, the EEG (only a mild excess of theta) and the routine CSF show nothing definite. Which next steps are warranted? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先在病历终端查看入院时的MRI、脑电图和脑脊液报告，并了解近来的神经精神变化。
need.en: First read the admission MRI, EEG and CSF reports at a records terminal and find out about the recent neuropsychiatric changes.

text.zh-CN: 详细追问家族史：三代以内有没有人患过类似、进展迅速的神经精神疾病或顽固失眠
text.en: Take a detailed family history: anyone in three generations with a similar, rapidly progressive neuropsychiatric illness or intractable insomnia

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。家族史既是2018年共识的提示性特征，也决定后续基因检测和遗传咨询；原报告直到首诊后约5个月的专科门诊才记录到舅舅的类似病史。
feedback.en: Correct. The family history is a suggestive feature in the 2018 consensus and shapes genetic testing and counselling; the report records the uncle's similar illness only at the specialist clinic about 5 months after the first visit.

text.zh-CN: 送检血清和脑脊液自身免疫性脑炎抗体，并做副肿瘤筛查
text.en: Send serum and CSF autoimmune-encephalitis antibodies and screen for an underlying tumour

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。自身免疫性脑炎和副肿瘤综合征是作者列出的鉴别诊断，而且可以治疗；其诊断路径包括血清和脑脊液的神经元抗体检测（Graus 2016；中国2022自身免疫性脑炎共识）。抗IgLON5抗体相关疾病就以睡眠障碍伴睡眠呼吸异常为突出表现（Sabater 2014）。原报告没有这些检测。
feedback.en: Correct. Autoimmune encephalitis and paraneoplastic syndromes are in the authors' differential and are treatable; their diagnostic approach includes neuronal antibody testing in serum and CSF (Graus 2016; the Chinese 2022 consensus on autoimmune encephalitis). Anti-IgLON5 disease presents with a prominent sleep disorder and sleep-breathing abnormalities (Sabater 2014). The report has none of these tests.

text.zh-CN: 在遗传咨询和知情同意后做PRNP基因检测，并要求报告写明具体变异和129位密码子
text.en: PRNP gene testing after genetic counselling and consent, asking for the exact variant and codon 129 to be reported

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。遗传性朊蛋白病靠PRNP基因检测确诊（GeneReviews）；FFI对应D178N与129位甲硫氨酸位于同一等位基因（D178N-129M）。检测前要说明结果对亲属的意义并取得同意。
feedback.en: Correct. Genetic prion disease is confirmed by PRNP testing (GeneReviews); FFI is D178N on the same allele as methionine at codon 129 (D178N-129M). Before testing, explain what the result means for relatives and obtain consent.

text.zh-CN: 检查基本正常，按焦虑和失眠处理：阿普唑仑加量、停用避孕药，门诊随访即可
text.en: The tests are essentially normal: treat it as anxiety and insomnia — more alprazolam, stop the pill, outpatient follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。快速进展的认知下降、言语错乱、不自主运动和震颤不能用焦虑解释；共识指出FFI的辅助检查敏感性低，正常的MRI、脑电图和脑脊液常规不能让诊断停在这里。加量镇静催眠药也不会恢复睡眠。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Rapidly progressive cognitive decline, muddled speech, involuntary movements and tremor are not explained by anxiety; the consensus notes the low sensitivity of tests in FFI, so a normal MRI, EEG and routine CSF cannot end the work-up here. More sedative hypnotics will not restore sleep either.

text.zh-CN: 尽快行脑组织活检以明确诊断
text.en: Arrange a brain biopsy promptly to make the diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不恰当。疑似朊蛋白病时，脑组织属于WHO 2000所列的高感染性组织，活检器械需要专门处理；而遗传性朊蛋白病可以用血液PRNP基因检测确诊（GeneReviews），活检不是首选。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. With a prion disease possible, brain is a high-infectivity tissue in the WHO 2000 guidance and the instruments need special handling, while a genetic prion disease can be confirmed by PRNP testing on blood (GeneReviews) — biopsy is not the first step.

prompt.zh-CN: 对照原文表2转载的2018年中国专家共识（可能的／很可能的／确诊的FFI），本例记录的资料应如何分级？
prompt.en: Against the 2018 Chinese expert consensus that the report reproduces in its Table 2 (possible, probable, definite FFI), how should the recorded evidence be graded?

need.zh-CN: 先了解睡眠和神经精神症状、完成查体、追问家族史，并查看PRNP检测结果。
need.en: First establish the sleep and neuropsychiatric symptoms, examine her, take the family history and read the PRNP result.

text.zh-CN: 临床上为“很可能的FFI”（A组睡眠障碍＋B组快速进展的认知与神经精神症状，加上舅舅类似病史这一提示性特征）；报告只写“PRNP（+）”，没有D178N和129位密码子，“确诊”无法按同一标准核实
text.en: Probable FFI on clinical grounds (group A sleep disturbance + group B rapidly progressive cognitive and neuropsychiatric features, plus the uncle's similar illness as a suggestive feature); the report gives only “PRNP (+)” without D178N or codon 129, so “definite” cannot be checked against the same criteria

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。原文表2转载的2018年中国专家共识（Wu 2018）：A组＋1–2项B/C组核心特征为“可能”；两组以上核心特征再加一项以上提示性特征（RPD与失眠的阳性家族史、PSG证据、SPECT/PET丘脑低代谢）为“很可能”；“确诊”依赖PRNP检测，表2写明为D178N突变伴129位密码子多态性。本例C组自主神经表现、PSG和PET都没有报告，舅舅“类似症状”的细节也未展开，所以“很可能”是记录资料能支持的上限。“PRNP（+）”可以对应多种PRNP致病变异（遗传性CJD和GSS都在作者的鉴别诊断中），需要写明变异的完整报告。2022年修订标准（Chu 2022）保留了“可能＋阳性家族史或v-PSG/PET/SPECT异常＝很可能”的层级。
feedback.en: Correct. The 2018 Chinese expert consensus reproduced in the source's Table 2 (Wu 2018): group A plus one or two group B/C core features is “possible”; two or more core groups plus at least one suggestive feature (a family history of RPD and insomnia, PSG evidence, thalamic hypometabolism on SPECT/PET) is “probable”; “definite” rests on PRNP testing, which Table 2 specifies as the D178N mutation with the codon-129 polymorphism. Here the group C autonomic features, PSG and PET are all unreported and the uncle's “similar symptoms” are not described, so “probable” is the most the recorded data support. “PRNP (+)” could mean any of several pathogenic PRNP variants — genetic CJD and GSS are both in the authors' differential — so a full report naming the variant is needed. The 2022 revision (Chu 2022) keeps the step from possible to probable with a positive family history or v-PSG/PET/SPECT abnormalities.

text.zh-CN: 已确诊FFI：PRNP阳性即满足确诊标准，无需再核对
text.en: Definite FFI: a positive PRNP result meets the definite criterion, so there is nothing further to check

feedback.zh-CN: 不够严谨。这是原报告的结论，但它自己转载的标准要求PRNP结果为D178N突变并注明129位密码子；“PRNP（+）”没有说明是哪个变异——同一基因的其他致病变异可表现为遗传性CJD或GSS（作者列出的鉴别诊断）。FFI对应D178N与129位甲硫氨酸位于同一等位基因（GeneReviews）。应索取完整报告（变异名称和129位基因型）后再定为“确诊”。
feedback.en: Not rigorous enough. That is the report's own conclusion, but the criteria it reproduces require the D178N mutation with codon 129 stated; “PRNP (+)” does not say which variant — other pathogenic variants of the same gene cause genetic CJD or GSS (the authors' own differential). FFI is D178N on the same allele as methionine at codon 129 (GeneReviews). Ask for the full report (the variant and the codon-129 genotype) before calling it definite.

text.zh-CN: 基本可排除朊蛋白病：颅脑MRI、脑静脉成像和脑脊液常规都正常，脑电图只是轻度异常
text.en: Prion disease is effectively excluded: brain MRI, MR venography and routine CSF are normal and the EEG is only mildly abnormal

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。2018年共识特别指出，FFI诊断困难的原因之一就是辅助检查敏感性低；共识的诊断要素是睡眠、神经精神和自主神经表现，加上PSG、SPECT/PET和家族史，并不包括MRI或脑脊液常规是否异常。正常的MRI、脑电图和脑脊液常规不能排除FFI。
feedback.en: Incorrect. The 2018 consensus points out that one reason FFI is hard to diagnose is the low sensitivity of diagnostic tests; its criteria rest on sleep, neuropsychiatric and autonomic features plus PSG, SPECT/PET and the family history — not on whether the MRI or routine CSF is abnormal. A normal MRI, EEG and routine CSF do not exclude FFI.

text.zh-CN: 无法分级：没有多导睡眠监测和PET，共识标准不能用于本例
text.en: It cannot be graded: without polysomnography and PET the consensus criteria cannot be applied

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。PSG和SPECT/PET只是提示性特征中的两项，不是前提：仅凭临床核心特征就能判断“可能的FFI”，阳性家族史本身也是提示性特征。缺少PSG和PET应写进证据边界，而不是放弃分级。
feedback.en: Incorrect. PSG and SPECT/PET are only two of the suggestive features, not prerequisites: the clinical core features alone reach “possible FFI”, and a positive family history is itself a suggestive feature. Missing PSG and PET belong in the evidence boundaries — they are no reason not to grade.

text.zh-CN: 焦虑相关的原发性失眠：避孕药诱发，苯二氮䓬类使病情加重
text.en: Primary insomnia with anxiety, triggered by the contraceptive pill and worsened by the benzodiazepine

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。焦虑确实存在，但它解释不了数月内进行性的记忆力和计算力下降、言语错乱、肢体不自主运动和震颤，也解释不了家族中类似的病例；服避孕药以后出现失眠只是时间先后，不能证明因果。
feedback.en: Incorrect. She is anxious, but anxiety does not explain months of progressive memory and calculation decline, muddled speech, involuntary limb movements and tremor, or a similar illness in the family; insomnia that followed starting the pill is a sequence, not proof of cause.

prompt.zh-CN: 遗传性朊蛋白病已进入鉴别诊断，PRNP检测也已安排。她入院时做过腰椎穿刺。今后诊疗中，哪项感染控制安排最恰当？
prompt.en: A genetic prion disease is now in the differential and PRNP testing is planned. She had a lumbar puncture during the admission. Which infection-control arrangement is right for her care from now on?

need.zh-CN: 先完成下一步检查的决策，并查看入院时的脑脊液报告。
need.en: First decide the next steps in the work-up and read the admission CSF report.

text.zh-CN: 日常护理按标准预防，无需隔离；有创操作、脑脊液和组织标本按TSE感染控制要求处理：标注并告知检验科，尽量用一次性器械，接触高感染性组织的器械按专门程序灭活或销毁
text.en: Standard precautions for routine care, no isolation; invasive procedures, CSF and tissue specimens under TSE precautions: label them and tell the laboratory, single-use instruments where possible, and instruments that touch high-infectivity tissue decontaminated by TSE-specific methods or destroyed

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。WHO 2000 TSE感染控制指南：脑、脊髓和眼为高感染性组织，脑脊液的感染性较低；完整皮肤接触的风险可忽略，患者无需隔离，也不应因此被拒绝任何检查或治疗；真正需要管理的是有创操作的器械和标本。朊蛋白能耐受常规消毒灭菌。加拿大CJD感染控制指南把GSS和FFI患者也列为需要这些措施的人群。原报告没有提到感染控制。
feedback.en: Correct. WHO 2000 TSE infection-control guidelines: brain, spinal cord and eye are high-infectivity tissues and CSF carries less infectivity; contact with intact skin carries negligible risk, so the patient needs no isolation and must not be denied any test or treatment — what needs managing is the instruments and specimens of invasive procedures. Prions resist routine disinfection and sterilisation. The Canadian CJD infection-control guidance lists patients with GSS and FFI among those these measures apply to. The report mentions no infection control.

text.zh-CN: 单间隔离，所有接触者戴N95口罩，按空气和接触传播隔离
text.en: Single-room isolation, N95 respirators for everyone, airborne and contact precautions

feedback.zh-CN: 不需要。朊蛋白病不经空气、飞沫或日常接触传播；WHO 2000指出这类患者无需隔离。过度隔离增加她和家属的负担，却没有针对真正的风险——有创操作的器械和标本。
feedback.en: Not needed. Prion disease does not spread by air, droplets or everyday contact, and WHO 2000 says these patients need no isolation. Over-isolation burdens her and her family and misses the real risk — instruments and specimens from invasive procedures.

text.zh-CN: 不需要特殊措施：这是遗传病，不是传染病
text.en: No special measures: this is a genetic disease, not an infection

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。遗传性朊蛋白病的异常朊蛋白同样可以经器械和组织医源性传播，这正是TSE感染控制针对的风险；加拿大CJD感染控制指南把GSS和FFI患者也列为需要这些措施的人群。
feedback.en: Incorrect. The abnormal prion protein of genetic prion disease can also be transmitted iatrogenically through instruments and tissue — exactly the risk TSE precautions target; the Canadian CJD guidance lists patients with GSS and FFI among those the measures apply to.

text.zh-CN: 今后不再给她做任何有创操作，包括腰椎穿刺、胃管和静脉穿刺
text.en: No further invasive procedures for her — no lumbar puncture, feeding tube or even venepuncture

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。WHO 2000指出，不应因TSE而拒绝患者任何需要的检查或治疗；要改变的是器械和标本的处理方式。
feedback.en: Incorrect. WHO 2000 says a patient must not be denied any needed test or treatment because of a TSE; what changes is how instruments and specimens are handled.

text.zh-CN: 复用器械沿用常规清洗和高压灭菌即可
text.en: Routine cleaning and standard autoclaving of reusable instruments is enough

feedback.zh-CN: 不够。朊蛋白能耐受常规消毒和灭菌方法；接触高感染性组织的器械要按WHO 2000推荐的TSE专门程序处理或直接销毁，能用一次性器械时优先一次性。
feedback.en: Not enough. Prions survive routine disinfection and sterilisation; instruments that touch high-infectivity tissue need the TSE-specific methods WHO 2000 recommends, or destruction, and single-use instruments are preferred where possible.

prompt.zh-CN: PRNP检测回报“阳性”，她舅舅曾有类似病史。关于家族成员的风险和检测，最恰当的做法是？
prompt.en: The PRNP test comes back “positive”, and her uncle had a similar illness. What is the best approach to her relatives' risk and testing?

need.zh-CN: 先追问家族史，并查看PRNP检测结果。
need.en: First take the family history and read the PRNP result.

text.zh-CN: 转介遗传咨询：说明常染色体显性遗传，每个子女有50%的遗传风险；高风险成年亲属是否做预测性检测，在咨询后自愿决定（包括有权不知道）；同时索取写明具体变异的完整报告
text.en: Refer to clinical genetics: explain autosomal dominant inheritance and the 50% risk to each child; at-risk adult relatives decide about predictive testing voluntarily after counselling (including the right not to know); and obtain the full report naming the variant

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。GeneReviews：携带者的每个子女有50%的概率遗传致病变异。舅舅是母亲一方的亲属，提示风险可能来自母系，但母亲的健康和基因状况原报告没有记录，不能推断。疾病目前无法根治，预测性检测须在遗传咨询后由本人自愿决定；亲属检测还需要先知道她的具体变异。
feedback.en: Correct. GeneReviews: each child of a carrier has a 50% chance of inheriting the pathogenic variant. The uncle is on her mother's side, which suggests the risk may come through the maternal line, but her mother's health and genetic status are not recorded and must not be inferred. With no curative treatment, predictive testing is a voluntary choice after counselling, and testing relatives first needs her exact variant.

text.zh-CN: 建议所有亲属，包括孩子，马上都去做PRNP检测
text.en: Advise every relative, children included, to have PRNP testing straight away

feedback.zh-CN: 不恰当。预测性检测必须知情、自愿，并在遗传咨询之后进行；一刀切地要求所有人检测不尊重个人选择。亲属检测还需要先知道她的具体变异。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Predictive testing must be informed, voluntary and preceded by genetic counselling; telling everyone to be tested disregards each person's choice. Testing relatives also needs her exact variant first.

text.zh-CN: 舅舅当年诊断的是脑萎缩和帕金森病，和她的病无关，家属不用担心
text.en: Her uncle had brain atrophy and Parkinson's disease, which is unrelated; the family need not worry

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。舅舅当年的诊断没有经过基因证实；他“类似症状”的病史正是2018年共识列出的提示性特征（RPD与失眠的阳性家族史），不能因为旧的诊断名称就忽略。
feedback.en: Incorrect. The uncle's diagnosis was never confirmed genetically; his “similar symptoms” are exactly the suggestive feature the 2018 consensus lists (a family history of RPD and insomnia), and an old diagnostic label is no reason to dismiss them.

text.zh-CN: 告诉家属：她母亲一定是携带者，应该马上检测
text.en: Tell the family that her mother must be a carrier and should be tested now

feedback.zh-CN: 不能这样推断。舅舅提示母系可能有风险，但母亲的健康和基因状况原报告都没有记录；不能把推测当作事实告诉家属，母亲是否检测同样要在遗传咨询后自愿决定。
feedback.en: That cannot be inferred. The uncle points to a possible maternal-line risk, but her mother's health and genetic status are not recorded; a guess must not be presented to the family as fact, and whether her mother is tested is likewise her own choice after counselling.

text.zh-CN: 为了不让家属焦虑，暂时不告诉他们遗传风险
text.en: Hold back the genetic risk from the family so as not to alarm them

feedback.zh-CN: 不恰当。在患者同意的前提下与家属坦诚沟通遗传风险并提供遗传咨询，是亲属能够自主决定的前提；隐瞒会剥夺他们的选择。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. With her consent, an honest conversation about genetic risk plus an offer of counselling is what lets relatives make their own decisions; withholding it takes that choice away.

text.zh-CN: 首诊时问清睡眠问题的表现、起病和用药的先后、体重下降和自行服用的药物
text.en: At the first visit, established what the sleep problem is like, its onset relative to medicines, the weight loss and the self-medication

text.zh-CN: 入院时从家属处了解快速进展：言语错乱、不自主运动、记忆力下降和入院主诉
text.en: On admission, learned the rapid progression from her family: muddled speech, involuntary movements, memory decline and the admission complaint

text.zh-CN: 追问到家族史（舅舅的类似病史）
text.en: Elicited the family history (the uncle's similar illness)

text.zh-CN: 检查认知（记忆、计算力）和运动（肌张力、震颤）
text.en: Examined cognition (memory, calculation) and movement (tone, tremor)

text.zh-CN: 在病历中调阅入院时的MRI和MRV、脑电图和脑脊液报告
text.en: Reviewed the admission MRI and MRV, EEG and CSF reports in the record

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对下一步检查：家族史、自身免疫性脑炎抗体和副肿瘤筛查、咨询后的PRNP检测
text.en: Chose the next steps correctly at the first attempt: family history, autoimmune-encephalitis antibodies and a tumour screen, PRNP testing after counselling

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按2018年共识把记录资料分级为“很可能的FFI”，并指出“确诊”因缺少具体变异而无法核实
text.en: Graded the recorded evidence as probable FFI by the 2018 consensus at the first attempt, noting that “definite” cannot be checked without the variant

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对感染控制安排，落实TSE防护措施，且没有不必要地隔离患者
text.en: Chose the infection-control arrangement correctly at the first attempt, put TSE precautions in place and did not isolate her unnecessarily

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对家属风险与预测性检测的做法，并转介遗传咨询
text.en: Chose the approach to relatives' risk and predictive testing correctly at the first attempt and referred for genetic counselling

text.zh-CN: 请舒缓医疗会诊，并开始预立医疗照护计划（喂养方式、抢救意愿、照护地点）
text.en: Referred to palliative care and began advance care planning (feeding, resuscitation, place of care)

text.zh-CN: 规划检查之后，没有把加量镇静催眠药当作治疗
text.en: Once the work-up was planned, did not treat her with escalating sedative hypnotics

text.zh-CN: 与患者和家属沟通：病情、证据的不确定性、遗传风险和照护目标
text.en: Talked with her and her family about the illness, the uncertainty in the evidence, the genetic risk and the goals of care

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现：先了解对方已知道什么、想知道多少；用通俗语言说明这是一种快速进展、目前无法根治的疾病，诊断依据和仍不确定之处（基因报告没写具体变异）都说清楚，不给虚假的希望，也不过早下定论；解释常染色体显性遗传和每个子女50%的风险，强调亲属检测在遗传咨询后自愿决定，不推断母亲的基因状况；趁她还能表达意愿，邀请她本人参与喂养方式、抢救意愿和照护地点的讨论；回应焦虑，给出联系人和下一步安排，并用回授法确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Good practice: find out what they already know and how much they want to know; explain in plain words that this is a rapidly progressive illness with no curative treatment, saying both what the diagnosis rests on and what remains uncertain (the genetic report names no variant), without false hope or a premature verdict; explain autosomal dominant inheritance and the 50% risk to each child, stress that relatives decide about testing voluntarily after counselling, and do not infer her mother's status; while she can still say what she wants, involve her in decisions about feeding, resuscitation and place of care; respond to anxiety, give a named contact and the next steps, and check understanding by teach-back.

name.zh-CN: 带教上级医师
name.en: Attending

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是一篇已发表病例的分阶段回看。用苏格拉底式提问带教：请学员先核对当前阶段已有的证据，再列鉴别诊断；对数月内快速进展的认知和神经精神症状，提醒学员把可治疗的病因（自身免疫性、副肿瘤性）和遗传性病因都考虑进去，正常的常规检查不能让评估就此停止；诊断分级时请学员对照报告引用的诊断标准逐项核对，并说出缺失的证据；讨论安全问题时请学员说明有创操作、标本和器械的处理依据。原报告团队的处置不自动成为今天的推荐；不替学员下诊断结论，也不提前说出检查结果。
knowledge.en: This is a staged review of a published case. Teach Socratically: have the learner check the evidence available in the current phase before listing a differential; for cognitive and neuropsychiatric decline that progresses over months, prompt them to consider treatable causes (autoimmune, paraneoplastic) as well as genetic ones, and not to let normal routine tests end the work-up; when they grade the diagnosis, ask them to check the criteria the report cites item by item and to name the missing evidence; on safety, ask what the handling of invasive procedures, specimens and instruments rests on. What the report's team did is not automatically today's recommendation; do not make the diagnosis for the learner or reveal results in advance.

name.zh-CN: 病区护士
name.en: Ward nurse

knowledge.zh-CN: 负责病区事务和交接：标本送检、联系感染控制科和营养科、吞咽筛查、鼻胃管护理。不知道病例记录以外的信息；不解读检查结果，也不谈诊断。
knowledge.en: Handles ward logistics and handover: sending specimens, contacting infection control and the dietitian, swallow screening and nasogastric tube care. Knows nothing beyond the case record; does not interpret results or discuss the diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：快速进展的失眠与神经精神症状
title.en: Debrief: rapidly progressive insomnia with neuropsychiatric decline

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告诊断家族性致死性失眠症（FFI）：31岁女性以睡眠障碍起病，数月内出现快速进展的认知和神经精神症状、不自主运动和震颤，舅舅有类似病史，PRNP检测报告“阳性”。按原文转载的2018年中国专家共识，记录资料符合“很可能的FFI”；报告没有给出D178N和129位密码子，“确诊”无法按同一标准核实。MRI、脑电图和脑脊液常规正常不能排除本病。她在首诊后约9–10个月死于呼吸衰竭。
conclusion.en: The report diagnoses fatal familial insomnia (FFI): a 31-year-old woman whose illness began with disturbed sleep developed, within months, rapidly progressive cognitive and neuropsychiatric decline, involuntary movements and tremor; her maternal uncle had a similar illness and her PRNP test was reported “positive”. By the 2018 Chinese consensus the source reproduces, the recorded evidence fits probable FFI; the report gives neither D178N nor codon 129, so “definite” cannot be checked against the same criteria. A normal MRI, EEG and routine CSF do not exclude the disease. She died of respiratory failure about 9–10 months after the first visit.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 时间先后不等于因果：睡眠变差出现在服避孕药之后、新冠阳性出现在入院前几天，这些只是时间线上的事件。
keyReasoning.en: Sequence is not causation: the poor sleep followed starting the pill and the COVID test was positive days before admission — events on the timeline, not causes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 数月内从失眠发展到记忆和计算力下降、言语错乱、不自主运动和震颤，是快速进展的神经精神综合征，不能用焦虑或安眠药解释。
keyReasoning.en: Progression over months from insomnia to failing memory and calculation, muddled speech, involuntary movements and tremor is a rapidly progressive neuropsychiatric syndrome that anxiety or sleeping tablets do not explain.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 家族史在首诊后约5个月才被记录；它既是共识的提示性特征，也是基因检测和遗传咨询的起点。
keyReasoning.en: The family history was recorded only about 5 months after the first visit; it is both a suggestive feature in the consensus and the starting point for genetic testing and counselling.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: MRI、脑电图和脑脊液常规正常，在FFI中并不意外；正常结果应促使你寻找共识要求的证据（PSG、PET、家族史、基因），并排除可治疗的病因。
keyReasoning.en: A normal MRI, EEG and routine CSF are no surprise in FFI; they should send you to the evidence the consensus asks for (PSG, PET, family history, genetics) and to the treatable causes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: “PRNP（+）”是结论而不是报告：没有变异名称和129位基因型，就无法按原文转载的标准核实“确诊”，也无法给亲属做针对性检测。
keyReasoning.en: “PRNP (+)” is a conclusion, not a report: without the variant and the codon-129 genotype, “definite” cannot be checked against the criteria the source reproduces, and relatives cannot be offered targeted testing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病程时长的自相矛盾要标出来：作者称约9个月，文中日期给出首诊至死亡约9–10个月，按入院主诉推算的起病至死亡约12个月。
keyReasoning.en: Flag the inconsistent duration: the authors say about nine months; the dates give about 9–10 months from the first visit to death and about 12 months from the onset implied by the admission complaint.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是一篇单个病例报告的回看：PRNP具体变异、自主神经表现、PSG和PET都没有报告，“很可能”是记录资料能支持的上限；作者所述病程时长与文中日期不一致；感染控制、遗传咨询和舒缓照护是按现行指南加入的教学内容，原报告没有记录这些措施。病例中的处置不代表报告团队当时的做法。
boundaries.en: This reviews a single case report: the PRNP variant, autonomic features, PSG and PET are not reported, so “probable” is the most the recorded data support; the duration the authors give conflicts with the dates in the text; infection control, genetic counselling and palliative care are teaching content added from current guidance and are not recorded in the report. Management offered in the case does not represent what the report's team did.

unknowns.zh-CN: PRNP具体变异、129位密码子基因型、杂合状态和致病性分级（报告只写“PRNP（+）”）。
unknowns.en: The PRNP variant, codon-129 genotype, zygosity and pathogenicity class (the report gives only “PRNP (+)”).

unknowns.zh-CN: 自主神经表现（血压、心率、出汗、呼吸节律）及任何一次就诊的生命体征。
unknowns.en: Autonomic features (blood pressure, heart rate, sweating, breathing pattern) and vital signs at any visit.

unknowns.zh-CN: 自身免疫性脑炎抗体、副肿瘤筛查；MRI是否包括DWI序列；脑脊液逐项数值、14-3-3蛋白和RT-QuIC。
unknowns.en: Autoimmune-encephalitis antibodies and a paraneoplastic screen; whether the MRI included DWI; itemised CSF values, 14-3-3 protein and RT-QuIC.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首诊时的体格检查和处理；阿普唑仑的剂量和疗程；其他既往史、过敏史、手术史、吸烟饮酒和职业。
unknowns.en: The examination and management at the first visit; the alprazolam dose and duration; other past history, allergies, operations, smoking, alcohol and occupation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 原文“其后出现感能力差”含义不明（打印版亦如此），未采用，也未改写成“记忆”或“感知”。
unknowns.en: The source's phrase “其后出现感能力差” is unclear (so printed) and is not used, nor rewritten as “memory” or “perception”.

unknowns.zh-CN: 母亲及其他亲属的健康和基因状况；舅舅的具体症状和病程。
unknowns.en: Her mother's and other relatives' health and genetic status; the uncle's actual symptoms and course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 每次入院的具体治疗（“支持治疗”、肺炎和低血糖的处理）；尸检。
unknowns.en: The treatment given at each admission (the “supportive treatment”, the management of the pneumonia and the hypoglycaemia); autopsy.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 用标准给诊断分级，而不是复述报告的结论：2018年中国专家共识（Wu 2018，原文表2转载）区分可能、很可能和确诊的FFI，2022年修订版（Chu 2022）增加了两项排除条件并保留“阳性家族史或v-PSG/PET/SPECT异常可把‘可能’升为‘很可能’”的层级。本例记录资料达到“很可能”；“PRNP（+）”没有写明变异，而FFI对应的是D178N与129位甲硫氨酸位于同一等位基因（GeneReviews 2021）。
teachingPoints.en: Grade the diagnosis against criteria instead of repeating the report's conclusion: the 2018 Chinese expert consensus (Wu 2018, reproduced in the source's Table 2) separates possible, probable and definite FFI, and the 2022 revision (Chu 2022) adds two exclusion items while keeping the step from possible to probable with a positive family history or v-PSG/PET/SPECT abnormalities. The recorded data here reach “probable”; “PRNP (+)” names no variant, whereas FFI is D178N on the same allele as methionine at codon 129 (GeneReviews, 2021 update).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 正常的MRI、脑电图和脑脊液常规不能排除FFI：2018年共识强调辅助检查敏感性低，诊断要素是睡眠、神经精神和自主神经表现，加上PSG、SPECT/PET和家族史。本例的C组表现、PSG和PET都没有记录——把它们写进证据边界。
teachingPoints.en: A normal MRI, EEG and routine CSF do not exclude FFI: the 2018 consensus stresses the low sensitivity of diagnostic tests and builds the diagnosis on sleep, neuropsychiatric and autonomic features plus PSG, SPECT/PET and the family history. Here the group C features, PSG and PET are all unrecorded — they belong in the evidence boundaries.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先排除可治疗的类似疾病：自身免疫性脑炎和副肿瘤综合征是作者自己列出的鉴别诊断，应送检血清和脑脊液抗体并筛查肿瘤（Graus 2016；中国自身免疫性脑炎诊治专家共识2022年版）；抗IgLON5抗体相关疾病以睡眠障碍伴睡眠呼吸异常为突出表现（Sabater 2014）。原报告没有这些检测。
teachingPoints.en: Exclude the treatable mimics first: autoimmune encephalitis and paraneoplastic syndromes are in the authors' own differential, so test serum and CSF antibodies and screen for a tumour (Graus 2016; Chinese expert consensus on autoimmune encephalitis, 2022 edition); anti-IgLON5 disease presents with a prominent sleep disorder and sleep-breathing abnormalities (Sabater 2014). The report has none of these tests.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 一旦怀疑朊蛋白病（包括遗传型），就按WHO 2000 TSE感染控制指南处理：日常护理按标准预防、无需隔离、不拒绝任何需要的检查或治疗；脑、脊髓和眼是高感染性组织，脑脊液感染性较低；有创操作的器械和标本按TSE要求处理——尽量用一次性器械，接触高感染性组织的器械按专门程序灭活或销毁，标本标注并告知检验科。加拿大CJD感染控制指南（2007）把GSS和FFI患者也列入。本例做过腰椎穿刺，原报告没有提到任何防护措施。
teachingPoints.en: Once prion disease (including the genetic forms) is suspected, follow the WHO 2000 TSE infection-control guidelines: standard precautions for routine care, no isolation, no needed test or treatment withheld; brain, spinal cord and eye are high-infectivity tissues and CSF carries less infectivity; the instruments and specimens of invasive procedures are handled under TSE precautions — single-use instruments where possible, instruments that touch high-infectivity tissue decontaminated by TSE-specific methods or destroyed, specimens labelled and the laboratory told. The Canadian CJD infection-control guide (2007) includes patients with GSS and FFI. She had a lumbar puncture; the report mentions no precautions.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 遗传咨询与家属：常染色体显性遗传，携带者每个子女有50%的风险（GeneReviews 2021）。舅舅提示风险可能来自母系，但母亲的情况没有记录，不能推断；高风险成年亲属是否做预测性检测，在遗传咨询后自愿决定，而且需要先知道她的具体变异。
teachingPoints.en: Genetic counselling and the family: autosomal dominant inheritance, a 50% risk to each child of a carrier (GeneReviews, 2021 update). The uncle suggests a maternal-line risk, but her mother's status is not recorded and must not be inferred; at-risk adult relatives decide about predictive testing voluntarily after counselling, and testing them first needs her exact variant.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 尽早规划舒缓照护：遗传性朊蛋白病目前没有针对病因的治疗（GeneReviews 2021）。本例的后续病程——肺炎、吞咽下降需要胃管、低血糖和营养不良、呼吸衰竭死亡——说明喂养方式、抢救意愿和照护地点要在她还能表达意愿时就讨论。原报告没有记录舒缓医疗或预立医疗照护计划。
teachingPoints.en: Plan palliative care early: genetic prion disease has no treatment of its cause (GeneReviews, 2021 update). Her later course — pneumonia, failing swallowing needing a feeding tube, hypoglycaemia and malnutrition, death from respiratory failure — shows why feeding, resuscitation and place of care should be discussed while she can still say what she wants. The report records no palliative care or advance care planning.
